matching.window: an alert matches an event when it is on the event's ward (and resistance type, or drug for a rate shift), from a detector meant for that mechanism, between the event's start and 28 days after its end (3 days after for data faults, plus the backfill delay)
matching.episodes: ward/poisson/abg: each crossing into the flagged state; cluster: each new cluster (growth is a follow-up); gap/late: runs on one ward with gaps of <= 3 days
matching.denominator: days / 7 x 9 wards (clusters and first-ever types are counted against the same ward-weeks)
matching.history_baseline: the history is replayed from 2024-10-29: the ward rule needs 393 days of baseline
matching.qualification: Unmatched alerts are not proven false positives. Cluster matches require the organism and a case sampled on the event ward within its documented window. No match before the first observable case. Episodes count as matched if any update matches.
